newsitem.title: UK: Hitachi to use MSAS distribution ce.
newsitem.headline: Hitachi to use MSAS distribution ce.

text.p: MSAS Cargo International said it will manage a 37,600 sq ft facility at Egham near Heathrow airport as the European warehouse and distribution centre for Hitachi Ltd's computer storage products, mainly hard disc and CD-ROM drives.
The leased facility includes 6,600 sq ft of office space, an MSAS statement said. MSAS is a unit of British marine and environmental services firm Ocean Group Plc.

"In effect, we are part of the supply chain management for Hitachi, controlling the movement of goods from its Far East plants through to our UK warehouse," MSAS commercial manager Egham, John Bowley, added.
"From Egham, we manage delivery of goods throughout the UK and across mainland Europe as part of a door-to-door service", he said.
MSAS local offices liaise with Hitachi plants in Japan and the Philippines and arrange forwarding to the UK by sea, air and by sea/air via Vancouver.

Data is automatically downloaded between the two partners. Information on shipping instructions, dispatch notes, labels and invoices on Hitachi letterheads for each order is transmitted directly to Egham, while MSAS supplies Hitachi with full receipt and dispatch information for tracing purposes.
Hitachi sells on a delivered to door basis through a 24, 48 or 72 hour service.
MSAS plans the load and route delivery using the most suuitable methods. Each shipment is tracked and proof of delivery electronically transferred to Hitachi, the statement said.
Once a fortnight, a printout is sent to Hitachi showing a full list of all orders dispatched during the period, together with a one line invoice of all freight charges.
